title: Don't Discard All the Biased Instances: Investigating a Core Assumption in Dataset Bias Mitigation Techniques

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the reliance of models on superficial dataset cues and spurious correlations by comparing the token-level feature importance between a main model and biased models (partial-input and limited-capacity models). The evaluation uses a word-omission technique to measure token impact on logits, calculates cosine similarity between the resulting vectors, and validates the findings through human annotation.
